answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Each of 566 aliases needs its own order histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A saddler workshop record with harness order history works as the gate: harness orders fulfilled by one saddlery over years. Watch the haven: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the vine bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the beacon audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
